component_family: 16 independent real anti-Hermitian components per R/time, excluding 10 analytically roundoff-only imaginary components at half-box R32; 324 tested components total. Full matrix imaginary components also exported descriptively.
bootstrap_null: Recenter each configuration component at zero; resample whole configuration vectors together; studentize with the resampled SE; compare maximum absolute t over the full 324-component family. Empirical conditional calibration, not a proof of Hermiticity.
outer_jackknife: 71 complete delete-one repeats; original fold membership fixed for each split; training and metric recomputed in each deletion. Splits are sensitivity choices, not independent ensembles.
additional_control: Published same-sample means and full retraining jackknife retained; alternating-fold outputs freshly reproduced against published cache.
model: A exp[-E (tau-tau_min)] for real part of projected ensemble means; A signed, E allowed negative. Diagnostic one-state ansatz, no spectral positivity assumption.
refinement: Bracket profile-gradient sign changes on complete energy grid and refine minima with Brent root solves; compare all minima and endpoints. Signed amplitude eliminated analytically.
fit_covariance: Full-sample complete-retraining outer-jackknife mean covariance, correlation-scaled Cholesky, held fixed in every parameter refit. No regularization, pseudoinverse or diagonal fallback.
fit_jackknife: Refit all 71 deletion means with fixed full-sample covariance; retain boundary counts and failed/invalid cases.
goodness: Gaussian chi-square tails with estimated covariance are approximate diagnostic values, not calibrated acceptance probabilities. No automatic potential selection.
comparison: Pair each split/basis/training/window change on identical deleted configurations. Compare direct-correlator fits with corresponding six-point effective-energy constants.
interpretation: Candidate energies and diagnostics only. Single fixed t0 cannot settle open-boundary systematics; no physical GEVP levels, Cornell fit, string tension or new clover profiles.
